summary: The Lake House on Canandaigua, an upscale hotel at 770 S. Main St. in Canandaigua, will serve a Thanksgiving buffet featuring classics like pumpkin bisque soup, sweet potato gratin and roasted organic turkey with sage walnut stuffing. Stations will also include a raw bar, desserts display and kids station.
